import sys

def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    
    while idx < len(input_data):
        n = int(input_data[idx]); idx += 1
        if n == 0:
            break
        
        planets = []
        for _ in range(n):
            d = int(input_data[idx]); idx += 1
            t = int(input_data[idx]); idx += 1
            volumes = [int(input_data[idx+j]) for j in range(d)]
            idx += d
            planets.append((d, t, volumes))
        
        # Collect all candidate time offsets
        candidates = set()
        for (d, t, volumes) in planets:
            for k in range(d):
                # transition at offset: when planet goes from hour k-1 to k
                # planet i is at hour k when (t + offset) % d == k
                # offset = (k - t) % d
                offset = (k - t) % d
                candidates.add(offset)
        
        max_vol = 0
        for offset in candidates:
            total = sum(volumes[(t + offset) % d] for (d, t, volumes) in planets)
            if total > max_vol:
                max_vol = total
        
        print(max_vol)
